tips.title: Define coordinate system for CAM part
tips.body: Select 'Top center of model box' as the origin in the Place CoordSys origin to section.

tips.title: Set stock for CAM part
tips.body: Select the solid body as the stock in the Defined by list.

tips.title: Set target for CAM part
tips.body: Select the solid body as the target in the Defined by list.

tips.title: Add fixture to CAM part
tips.body: Select the highlighted part as the fixture and add it at the start of operations tree.

tips.title: Set machine setup for CAM part
tips.body: Enter a value of 356.9 in the Z column to set the distance from the top face of the part to the bottom of the holding fixture.

tips.title: Add Morph between two boundary curves operation
tips.body: Select 'Morph between two boundary curves' from the Technology list.

tips.title: Select drive surface for Morph operation
tips.body: Click 'Drive surface' and select the faces as shown in the image.

tips.title: Select start edge curve for Morph operation
tips.body: Click 'Start edge curve' and select the curve as shown in the image.

tips.title: Select end edge curve for Morph operation
tips.body: Click 'End edge curve' and select the curve as shown in the image.

tips.title: Set type for Morph operation
tips.body: Click 'Type' and select 'Full, start and end at exact surface edges'.

tips.title: Set margins for Morph operation
tips.body: Enter the values as shown in the image to set the margins.

tips.title: Select tool for Morph operation
tips.body: Select 'Taper Mill' as the tool and enter the parameters as shown in the image.

tips.title: Select holder for Morph operation
tips.body: Select 'BT 40 ER 32X60' as the holder.

tips.title: Set levels for Morph operation
tips.body: Enter the parameters as shown in the image to set the levels.

tips.title: Set tool path parameters for Morph operation
tips.body: Enter a value of 0.8 in the Maximum step over field and select 'Approximate' from the Step over calculation list.

tips.title: Set tool axis control for Morph operation
tips.body: Enter a value of 70 in the Tilt angle at side of cutting field and select 'Orthogonal to cut direction at each position' from the Side tilt definition list.

tips.title: Set link for Morph operation
tips.body: Select 'Use Lead-In' from the First entry list and unselect the Use default Lead-In check box.

tips.title: Use Lead-Out for Morph operations
tips.body: Select Use Lead-Out in the Last exit list and configure parameters as shown.

tips.title: Configure Tool Axis Control for Morph operations
tips.body: Set Tilt angle at side of cutting field to 80 and select Follow surface ISO lines direction.

tips.title: Use Parallel to Curves strategy for uniform spacing
tips.body: Select Parallel to curves in the Technology list and configure parameters as shown.

tips.title: Configure Lead-In and Lead-Out for Parallel to Curves
tips.body: Clear Use default Lead-In/Out check boxes, enter parameters as shown, and select Use Lead-In/Out in the Links tab.

tips.title: Configure Morph between two adjacent surfaces
tips.body: Select Morph between two adjacent surfaces in the Technology list and configure parameters as shown.

tips.title: Set Tool Center based Calculation for Morph operations
tips.body: Select the Taper Mill tool and enable Tool Center based Calculation in the Misc. parameters page.

tips.title: Calculate tool path
tips.body: Click once after calculating the tool path to display the Simulation window.

tips.title: Fix tool path issues
tips.body: Ensure the tool path only machines the area to be machined and not other areas.

tips.title: Generate tool path front side
tips.body: Check the 'Generate tool path front side' box in the Advanced Options of Surface Paths Pattern window.

tips.title: Adjust margins
tips.body: Click Margins and enter parameters to reduce unwanted areas in the tool path.

tips.title: Select tool axis direction
tips.body: In the Tool axis control page, select 'Tilted through curve' in the Tool axis direction list.

tips.title: Set curve tilt type
tips.body: Click 'Angle from curve' in the Curve tilt type list.

tips.title: Select curve for tilt
tips.body: Select the curve under Tilt curve and click OK.
